title: Solving Equations of the First Degree with One Unknown
description: Solver for first degree equations with one unknown. Equations can be expressed as a1*x + c1 = a2*x + c2, and solved to find x.

components.content:
## Solving First Degree Equations with One Unknown

A first degree equation with one unknown can be expressed as:

**a₁x + c₁ = a₂x + c₂**

Which can be rearranged to solve for x:

**x = (c₂ - c₁) / (a₁ - a₂)**

### Example
For the equation: 22x - 10 = 12x + 20
- a₁ = 22, c₁ = -10
- a₂ = 12, c₂ = 20
- x = (20 - (-10)) / (22 - 12) = 30 / 10 = 3

inputs.label: a₁ (coefficient of x on left side)
a₂ (coefficient of x on right side)
